name: relai-cache-keeper
description: RelAI cache keeper for Claude Code (early access mods): five batteries above the prompt — the prompt cache's time left, the 5-hour limit, the time to its reset, the weekly limit and the context — each showing what is left, the full words on hover, with the session's hypothetical cost once, on the right, and a second row only when the cache cools, a hand-off is ready or a fresh session pays off (/cache shows the reckoning); a guard that asks before a cold send of a big context; keep-warm pings and a hand-off to a fresh chat (natively through the project documents in a RelAI project). It calls the model only on the person's explicit request: /keepwarm or the keep-warm button sends short pings, the hand-off sends its prompt as the person. Formerly cache-keeper-pl.
